name: Zetian
story: Recognized by the Heavens and cherished by her people, the Celestial Empress of the Cadia Riverlands ascends to bring peace to the mortal realm.

skills.name: Celestial Armament
skills.desc: Phoenix Crown: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with Phoenix Strike or Phoenix Descent, she gains 1% Spell Vamp for 5s (up to 10 stacks). Celestial Robe: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who approaches her, dealing 90(+10*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. She also gains a 300(+20*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) shield for 3s. Cooldown: 120s.

skills.name: Phoenix Strike
skills.desc: Zetian unleashes a Phoenix Wave in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave (up to 3 times). Zetian can cast other skills during this time. The waves deal 150 (+50% Total Magic Power), 150 (+50% Total Magic Power), and 360 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, respectively. The 3rd wave has a larger area and pulls enemies toward the cast direction (not considered a control effect). The Spell Vamp ratio against minions is only 65%.

skills.name: Phoenix Descent
skills.desc: Zetian summons a Phoenix Spirit at the target location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect to enemies in the area. The Phoenix Spirit hovers at the location for 3s, dealing 20 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.5s and reducing enemies' Magic Defense by 10% while revealing their surrounding area. While the Phoenix Spirit is active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect upon arrival.

skills.name: Fury of the Phoenix
skills.desc: Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 40% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes, dealing 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.8s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time. Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.
